chunks: My father, from Ahmad ibn Idris, from Muhammad ibn Ahmad, from Muhammad ibn al-Sindi, from Ali ibn al-Hakam, from Saif ibn Amirah, from Sa'd ibn Zarif, from al-Asbagh ibn Nubatah, who said:

The Commander of the Faithful (peace be upon him) said: Indeed, Allah, the Mighty and Glorious, intends to punish all the people of the earth, so that none would be spared from them, if they commit sins and commit evil deeds. But when He looks at the elderly, those carrying their feet towards the prayer, and the children who are learning the Quran, He has mercy on them and postpones that (punishment) from them.
ai.seo_question: Why does Allah delay punishment for humanity according to Imam Ali?
ai.summary: In this hadith from Thawab al-Amal, Imam Ali (AS) illustrates the divine mechanism of delaying general punishment (Takhir al-'Adhab) through specific acts of worship, highlighting the intercessory merit of the elderly's devotion and the youth's acquisition of knowledge. This reflects the Shia scholarly understanding that communal piety serves as a shield against widespread calamity, emphasizing the social responsibility of both generations in maintaining spiritual balance.

en.sayed-athar-husain-rizvi-&-sayed-maqs: 1.  Amirul Momineen (a.s.) says, “Whenever people of the earth  commit  sins  or  get  involved  in  wrong  deeds,  the Almighty Allah intends to send down His chastisement on the  people  of  the  world.  However  when  He  sees  elderly people walking towards Salaat and young children learning Quran, He feels pity on them and postpones it.”
